name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd
about: Pearl Global Industries Ltd. incorporated in 1987. [1] Pearl Global Industries Limited (PGIL) is a garment exporter, manufacturing from multiple sourcing regions within India and countries within South Asia. The product range includes knits, woven, and bottoms across men, women, and kids' wear segments. [2]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Pearl Global Industries is a global apparel manufacturing and export company, offering solutions including design, manufacturing, and supply chain management. It caters to top global fashion retailers through multi-country manufacturing facilities and strategic design and sales offices. The company focuses on women’s fashion, men’s wear, and kids' wear.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 57.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 25.3%
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.83%
